description: Notion task tracking integration system enabling programmatic task management via Notion API

functional.description: System shall create tasks in Notion database with title, assignee, and notes
System shall update task status and notes in Notion database
System should retrieve and list tasks from Notion database
System shall handle API errors gracefully with appropriate logging
System should filter tasks by status, assignee, or date
System should archive or delete tasks from Notion database

non_functional.description: System shall use environment variables for sensitive configuration
System shall provide meaningful error messages for debugging
Code shall follow modular design with reusable functions
Functions shall have clear documentation for usage

ambiguous_requirements.question: What is the expected behavior when Notion API rate limits are hit?
ambiguous_requirements.suggested_clarification: Define retry strategy and rate limit handling

ambiguous_requirements.question: Should the system support batch operations for multiple tasks?
ambiguous_requirements.suggested_clarification: Specify if bulk create/update operations are needed

ambiguous_requirements.question: What database schema fields are required in the Notion database?
ambiguous_requirements.suggested_clarification: Document expected Notion database structure and field types
